title: 7 nights.
6 ski days.
core.text: Our reference week — not a rule. Shorter or longer stays and custom dates are possible, depending on availability.

title: Straight from
the hotel door.
snowcat.text: Our PistenBully PB300W belongs to OrganixEvents Sàrl. Its passenger cabin takes your group from the hotel to the first run — no lifts, no queues, no other groups.

title: Good skier?
You're ready.
level.text: You ski confidently and autonomously on red and black runs. No off-piste experience needed — we adapt terrain, routes and pace to your group.

terrain.title: Wild mountains, still off the map.
terrain.text: The Šar Mountains rise above Popova Shapka in the west of North Macedonia: open faces, long ridges, trees and couloirs, far from mass tourism.

day.title: What a day can look like.
day.note: An example, not a timetable — every day follows the weather, the snow and the group.

steps.title: Breakfast & briefing
steps.text: Conditions briefing and avalanche equipment check.

steps.title: Snowcat up
steps.text: The snowcat leaves right from the hotel and takes you to the first line.

steps.title: Lunch on the mountain
steps.text: Picnic outside, or a hut when the weather turns.

steps.title: More laps
steps.text: Snowcat, skins or both — depending on the plan.

steps.title: Back at the hotel
steps.text: Sauna, jacuzzi, dinner and tomorrow's plan.

stay.title: Simple, warm, local.
stay.text: A small family hotel with sauna and jacuzzi. Double rooms; single room with a supplement. Full board: breakfast, picnic or lunch, dinner and water — alcohol and soft drinks are extra.

title: Travel light.
We have the gear.
gear.note: Rental is charged separately. Boots and helmets are not available for rent — bring your own.

beyond.title: The snowcat is just the beginning.
beyond.text: Depending on conditions and the group, the week can also include:
beyond.option: Option: a one- or two-day heliski extension in Albania, subject to conditions, availability and separate pricing. Never included or guaranteed.

items.title: Your group
items.text: Priced for 8, ideal around 10, 12 at the most. Friends, clubs, teams.

items.title: On your own, or two or three
items.text: You can join a compatible group, depending on dates, availability and levels.

items.title: Skiers and snowboarders
items.text: Both welcome. Not sure about your level? Tell us and we'll advise you honestly.

team.title: Local knowledge matters.
team.text: OrganixEvents runs and sells the experience and owns the snowcat. Wild Tracks is our local base, built with partners on the ground who bring the hotel, the logistics and the local relationships.

roles.title: OrganixEvents
roles.text: Your organiser and single point of contact, from the first message to the last day.

items.a: You should ski confidently and autonomously on red and black runs. No previous off-piste experience is required: we adapt the terrain to the group.

items.q: Do I have to come for a full week?
items.a: No. 7 nights and 6 ski days is our reference format. Shorter or longer stays and custom dates are possible, depending on availability.

items.q: What does the CHF 2,250 price include?
items.a: Per person, for a group of 8: 7 nights, 6 ski days with the private snowcat, two guides, full board and transfers from Skopje.
For a standard group, two guides: a local UIMLA guide and a guide from the Organix team.

items.q: I'm on my own, or we're two or three. Can we join?
items.a: Yes, you can join a compatible group, depending on dates, availability and levels.

items.q: Do I need my own freeride equipment?
items.a: No. Freeride skis, poles, airbags, transceivers, shovels, probes and touring gear can be rented on site. Boots and helmets are not available for rent.

items.q: Which airport do I fly to?
items.a: Transfers are organised from Skopje. Other airports are possible on conditions.
Send us an enquiry and we'll talk it through personally. We then send you the registration form. Once your place is confirmed, OrganixEvents invoices you directly, in CHF or EUR.

title: Your week.
Your way.
final.lead: Tell us your dates, your group and your level. We'll take care of the rest.
